dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: My liege, I am Sun Yu, disciple of the Guhua Clan; I have journeyed here to harness my inner energies... Well, to practice.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Did you want something? If not, please do not disturb me.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Have you not heard of the renowned ancient arts of the Guhua Clan?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: In its glory days, the Guhua Brotherhood roamed the lands freely and none dared to challenge them.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Their reputation for dual mastery of the polearm and sword was such that all the martial nomads in Teyvat had heard of it, and none doubted its veracity.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Sadly, no party is everlasting... Centuries have passed, and while many Guhua relics remain, the great practitioners are long gone.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: After a slew of desertions, the Guhua Brotherhood regrouped as the much smaller Guhua Sect, with barely a few hundred disciples. Today's Guhua Clan is now all that is left of this grand tradition, with a mere handful of practitioners ...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you two all that's left of the Guhua Clan?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Our numbers are reduced, yes, but not to that extent... It's just that the various disciples of our Clan have been scattered every corner of Liyue.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Traveler, have you heard of one known as Xingqiu?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: He is a junior of mine, but he was the first among us to grasp the concept of the Martial Principle.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: He once wrote a mantra and utterly changed the legacy of the Guhua Clan.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: I don't know what became of him. Perhaps he's still roaming the land, doing good wherever he goes. Hahaha...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: ...I guess there's no point hiding it from you if you're an outlander.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: The true purpose behind my journeying here is to seek divine guidance on the Way, to find a means of reviving the Guhua Clan.
